keyFindings.description: No committed test pins that two matches of a quote inside one code block count as one place. Both review agents changed MarkNotAllowedError.At to the refused range's start (find.go:1138) and every docs and pmdoc test still passed, while the 400 then read 'two code blocks … out of them' for one block. The unit case 'one place its quote stands in twice' passes one error value twice and never runs the mark writer. Add an upload row with the quote twice in one code block, expecting 'a code block … out of it'.
The At doc read as where the refused text (range) begins. Fixed by the reviewer in 8ca80716 (comment only): the start of the block's text run.

accepted: Round-5 findings fixed in 4be0d238 and confirmed: places are counted per kind (At is sound: each code block and the front matter hold one Yjs text run), the order test pins nearest first, err == ErrTargetNotFound, Find inlines find, and the loop decides each outcome where it happens with identical behaviour. Threads PRRT_kwDORFy7ds6xsYkA, …YkH, …YkM, …YkV, …YkY accepted. Not a defect: refusedPlace's structure (grouping by display text, a separate count loop), since it is correct and tested; counting is quadratic only in the error path (about 1 s at 65,536 refused code blocks), recorded under Not proven.
